id: title:DanielVisca:surface save errors and drop metrics for log transformations

observations.behavior: Adds toast notification for backend validation errors on Hog Function configuration submission.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides user feedback when a team lacks required feature gates or enabled-function caps without visible form fields.

observations.behavior: Adds new metric dimensions and metadata for tracking record drops in Hog Functions.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to distinguish between filtered, quota-limited, and dropped records, including PII scrubbing failures.

observations.behavior: Tests that deep-linked tabs are corrected if incompatible with loaded Hog Function type.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents broken UI state where no tab content renders after loading an incompatible transformation log.

observations.limitations: Changes are localized to Hog Function scene; no systemic architectural changes. No tier-3 evidence of broader reliability or adoption.

review.limitations: Changes are localized to Hog Function scene; no systemic architectural changes. No tier-3 evidence of broader reliability or adoption.
review.reason: Substantive bounded improvements: better error visibility, compatibility handling, and expanded metrics. Not broad enough for tier-3.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps maintain correct UX and diagnostics for the Hog Function product, especially around PII transformations and compatibility checks.
review.uncertainty: None; all hunks complete and relevant.
